national_law.name: Ley de Coordinacion y Gobernanza de la Ciberseguridad
national_law.formal_citation: Anteproyecto de Ley de Coordinacion y Gobernanza de la Ciberseguridad
national_law.status_note: Council of Ministers approved the draft (anteproyecto) on January 14, 2025. Public consultation completed January-February 2025. Pending parliamentary approval as of March 2026.

legislative_timeline.event: Council of Ministers approved the Anteproyecto de Ley
Public hearing and consultation period opened
European Commission sent reasoned opinion for failure to transpose

authorities.name: Centro Criptologico Nacional
authorities.role: CSIRT for public sector and essential entities

authorities.name: Instituto Nacional de Ciberseguridad
authorities.role: CSIRT for private sector and important entities

authorities.name: Centro Nacional de Proteccion de Infraestructuras y Ciberseguridad

proposed_features.national_cybersecurity_center: Establishment of a National Cybersecurity Center for coordination and governance
proposed_features.incident_reporting: Expected to align with NIS2 standard: 24h early warning, 72h notification, 1 month final report
proposed_features.penalties: Expected to align with NIS2 standard: up to EUR 10M / 2% turnover (essential), EUR 7M / 1.4% turnover (important)

infringement_proceedings.status: Spain has two months to respond to reasoned opinion

sources.title: DSN - Anteproyecto de Ley de Coordinacion y Gobernanza de la Ciberseguridad
Cuatrecasas - Aprobado el anteproyecto de Ley que transpone la Directiva NIS2

notes: Spain has NOT yet transposed NIS2 as of March 2026
The draft law (anteproyecto) was approved by Council of Ministers in January 2025
Parliamentary processing is ongoing - no BOE publication yet
European Commission infringement proceedings are active
Current NIS1 framework (RDL 12/2018) remains in force as interim measure
Multi-authority model proposed: CCN-CERT for public sector, INCIBE for private sector
